schools.name: Union City High School
schools.absence_instructions: Call the school between 7:45 and 9:30 AM to report an absence. On return, bring a written excuse signed by a parent or guardian; doctor's notes go to the nurse, and after a medical absence of 3 or more days the student must see the nurse before going to class.

schools.name: Eugenio Maria de Hostos Center for Early Childhood Education
schools.absence_instructions: Call the center your child attends to report the absence. A child who is absent or late regularly is referred to the Family Worker, who makes a home visit if the center hasn't been told by the 4th day. Keep a child home with diarrhea, vomiting, a temperature over 101.5, a sore throat or severe cough, red eyes with discharge or a stiff neck.

sacc.closures_notes: Pre-K wrap-around (free; eligibility based on family income), breakfast and snack included. The Timetable page gives the full day as 7:30 AM-5:00 PM.
